content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Meat is a ready‑to‑eat product made from selected beef or chicken, thermally processed and finely minced to a tender texture. The product contains no added sugar, salt or artificial preservatives, making it suitable for children from 12 months old.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The product undergoes double heat treatment to ensure microbiological safety.
A small amount of natural herbs and spices, approved for infant nutrition, is used to enhance flavor.
Each serving provides about 20 % protein, essential for growth and development.
It is packaged in sealed portion‑size pouches that can be heated directly in a microwave.
Shelf life is 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: High‑quality meat protein supports muscle growth and immune system development in toddlers.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Readily absorbable iron helps maintain normal blood formation and prevents anemia.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B12 and B6 contribute to nervous system function and energy metabolism.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: No added salt promotes healthy taste preferences in early childhood.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Fine texture and lack of tough fibers make the product gentle on a toddler’s stomach.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some children may develop an allergic reaction to beef or chicken; discontinue use if symptoms appear.

items.title: Overheating
items.content: Microwave heating can create hot spots; stir well before serving.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Opened pouches should be refrigerated and consumed within 24 hours.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the product in a microwave (30‑40 seconds) or steam it, then stir to a smooth consistency. Serve as a standalone meal or mixed with vegetable puree.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep unopened packages in a cool, dry place at 5‑25 °C. After opening, refrigerate and use within one day.
